1593 ekneuo {ek-nyoo'-o}

源自 1537 與 3506; 動詞

欽定本 - convey away 1; 1

1) 轉彎
2) 轉離  (#約5:13|)
record.edic_text:
1593 ekneuo {ek-nyoo'-o}

from 1537 and 3506;; v

AV - convey away 1; 1

1) to bend to one side
2) to take one's self away, to turn one's self, to avoid a thing
3) to swim away, escape by swimming
4) to escape, slip away secretly

same.cexp: 作手勢，招手或點頭示意（#路 1:22|）
